findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_api_key, infer_schema, validate · Private data: try_parse, create_api_key, parse_document, parse_text, infer_schema, validate, check_credits, list_schemas · Public sink: try_parse, create_api_key, parse_text · Destructive: try_parse.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_api_key, infer_schema, validate · Private data: try_parse, create_api_key, parse_document, parse_text, infer_schema, validate, check_credits, list_schemas · Public sink: try_parse, create_api_key, parse_text · Destructive: try_parse

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
